sections.body: You should have gotten your team number assigned at the start. If not or you forgot, introduce yourself to a team! Also, think of a team name. Some ideas to get you started: Drop table like it’s hot; dude, where’s my data; null pointer sisters; smells like updag in here

questions.text: Match each X-term to its definition:

matchPairs.definition: The bread-and-butter data format — if you deal with healthcare billing, you've had nightmares parsing an X12 EDI file.
Chi-Square: The stats test for comparing categorical variables in clinical data.
Laura Kinney — the mutant clone and adopted daughter of Wolverine (X-Men comics, the movie Logan).
Elon Musk and Grimes' famously unpronounceable kid — broke a few birth-certificate databases with its special characters.
The gradient-boosting library quietly powering a huge share of clinical risk-prediction and tabular-ML models.
The markup behind HL7 CDA / C-CDA clinical documents — the verbose ancestor before everyone moved to FHIR + JSON.
